## Convx 2.1.1

### Which APK?
- **`convx-2.1.1-arm64.apk`**: almost every phone from the last ~8 years. Pick this one.
- **`convx-2.1.1-arm32.apk`**: older or budget 32-bit phones.
- **`convx-2.1.1-x86_64.apk`**: emulators and Chromebooks.

There is no universal APK any more: it had become the same file as arm64.

### Smaller
- The APK is roughly a third of its old size.
- The vocal-separation model and the Japanese lyrics dictionary download the first time a feature needs them, instead of shipping inside every APK.
- Native libraries are stored compressed.

### Fixes
- Songs no longer pause by themselves while the web player is open. A browser that was only showing the song could take over playback and quietly pause the phone, while still showing the song as playing.
- In-app updates check this repository and download the APK built for your phone.
